summary.text: Mike Ouellet is a Republican state representative from Coos District 3 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where he has served since December 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Mike Ouellet lives in Colebrook, New Hampshire, and has served on the Coos County Planning Board.
Ouellet assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 7, 2022.
Ballotpedia lists him as a member of the Fish and Game and Marine Resources Committee for 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Coos 3.
